accepted_obligations.statement: Licensed recruitment agencies must not charge migrant workers placement fees.

evidence.quote: No licensed recruitment agency shall charge a migrant worker any placement fee; permissible costs are limited to those defined in §4(b).
The provisions in Part II take effect on 1 October 2026.

accepted_obligations.statement: Licensed recruitment agencies must reissue the published fee schedule within 30 days after issue.

evidence.quote: Each licensed recruitment agency must reissue its published fee schedule within 30 days after this amendment is issued. The reissued schedule must identify the BDT 0 worker-paid placement fee limit and distinguish employer-paid costs.
The provisions in Part II take effect on 1 October 2026.

accepted_obligations.statement: Employer-paid medical examination costs remain permissible when no cost is transferred to the worker.

evidence.quote: Employer-paid medical examination costs remain permissible under this amended synthetic rule when no amount is transferred to, deducted from, or reclaimed from the worker.
The provisions in Part II take effect on 1 October 2026.
